overview.title: Overview
overview.subtitle: Live connection status and what your routing policy is doing right now.
overview.state.vpn_only: VPN active — no physical link available for bypass
overview.notes_body:
• Bypass traffic leaves through your physical link using RoutePilot's own routing tables; nothing else on the system is modified.
• Connections opened before a rule was applied keep their original path until they reconnect.
• Domain rules route the addresses a domain resolves to. Sites behind a shared CDN may share addresses with other sites.
• Apps that use their own encrypted DNS (DoH) may resolve different addresses than the system does.
